custom_logic_notes: Scans recent 3 bars (shifts 0,1,2) for valid fractal levels. Uses the highest upper fractal as long breakout level and lowest lower fractal as short breakout level. When a fractal level has no value at a given shift, that bar is skipped. The EA resolves fractals at close prices by checking if bar close breaks above/below the detected fractal levels. Opposite positions are closed before opening new ones on reversal signals.
python_conversion_notes: Fractal detection in Python requires manual implementation: a fractal high is a bar whose high exceeds the highs of the N bars before and after it (typically N=2 for standard Williams fractals). Scan the last 3 completed bars for valid fractal levels, then check if the close price breaks above (long) or below (short) those levels. Digit adjustment logic: if price has 5 digits (or _Point < 0.001), multiply SL/TP input values by 10 to convert from 'pips' to 'points'. New bar detection can be implemented by comparing current bar timestamp with stored timestamp. Position check before entry is required — only enter when flat.
